les: Skepe wat nie wind nodig het nie
kaps_punt: Die eerste stoomskepe; Moderne vorms van vervoer van water

items.bewering: Op 'n dag sonder wind kon 'n seilskip nie vaar nie. Toe begin mense om 'n enjin op 'n boot te sit.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Age_of_Sail (sail depends on wind; steamers' independence from the wind was their decisive advantage); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steamboat

items.bewering: 'n Stoomskip is 'n skip wat deur 'n stoomenjin aangedryf word. Hy het dus nie wind of spierkrag nodig nie. So 'n skip kon op 'n dag met min of geen wind vaar.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steamship; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Age_of_Sail ('ability to keep a schedule regardless of the wind')

items.bewering: Robert Fulton het nie die stoomboot uitgevind nie. Ander mense het lank voor hom stoombote gebou.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steamboat and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robert_Fulton: Jouffroy's Pyroscaphe on the Saone 1783, Fitch's trial on the Delaware 1787 and passenger service 1790, Miller/Symington 1788-1789, Charlotte Dundas 1802-1803. Twenty to twenty-four years before 1807 supports 'lank voor hom'. The lesson states the careful version; no superlative is claimed for Fulton.

items.bewering: In 1807 het Fulton se boot op die Hudsonrivier in Amerika gevaar.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/North_River_Steamboat (first trip up the Hudson, 17 August 1807); https://www.invent.org/inductees/robert-fulton

items.bewering: Daardie vroeë boot het hout gebrand en nie steenkool nie.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/North_River_Steamboat and https://www.kellscraft.com/PicturesqueHudson/PicturesqueHudson03.html: the boat burned dry pine wood, sending smoke and sparks from the funnel.

items.bewering: 'n Skeprad aan elke kant het die water agtertoe gestoot.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/North_River_Steamboat; https://www.gracesguide.co.uk/PS_Clermont: two paddle wheels, one on either side of the hull, initially uncovered.

items.bewering: Sy boot het gewys dat 'n stoomboot gereeld en betroubaar kon vaar. Mense het kaartjies gekoop en saamgevaar.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robert_Fulton (credited with the first commercially successful steamboat); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/North_River_Steamboat (regular New York-Albany service; passengers paid fares). The lesson does not claim his was the first passenger service, which is right, because Fitch carried paying passengers in 1790 without commercial success.

items.bewering: Later het werkers steenkool in 'n groot vuur diep binne die skip geskep. Die vuur het die water in die skip se groot ketel laat kook.
items.blok: Hoe die groter stoomskepe ná Fulton gewerk het
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steamship (coal-fired boilers and stokers on later steamships); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Age_of_Sail (steamers needed coal bunkerage)

items.bewering: Kokende water verander in stoom, en die stoom stoot baie hard. Daardie stoot laat 'n deel binne die enjin beweeg. Die deel laat 'n skeprad aan die sykant of 'n skroef onder die water draai. Elkeen stoot die water agtertoe, en die skip beweeg vorentoe.
items.blok: Hoe die groter stoomskepe ná Fulton gewerk het
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steamship; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steamboat (steam pressure drives a piston, which turns paddle wheels or, from the 1840s, a screw propeller). The chain is correct in order and contains no comparison whose mapping could mislead; 'stoot water agtertoe, skip beweeg vorentoe' is the correct reaction principle.

items.bewering: Reise het nie meer op die wind gewag nie. / 'n Skip se aankomsdag kon vooruit beplan word.
items.blok: Wat verander het en wat dieselfde gebly het
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Age_of_Sail: steamships 'could keep a schedule regardless of the wind'.

items.bewering: 'n Stoomskip moes brandstof kry, maar 'n seilskip nie.
items.blok: Wat verander het en wat dieselfde gebly het
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Age_of_Sail: sailing ships 'did not require bunkerage for coal nor fresh water for steam'.

items.bewering: Vrag is steeds in 'n hawe gelaai en gelos. / Die weer op die oop see was steeds gevaarlik.
items.blok: Wat verander het en wat dieselfde gebly het
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steamship (steamships continued to load and discharge in ports and were still lost to storms); general maritime history, nothing to contradict.

items.bewering: Stoomskepe het seilskepe stadig maar seker vervang en nie oornag nie.
items.blok: Wat verander het en wat dieselfde gebly het
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Age_of_Sail: hybrid sail-steamships for decades; sail stayed competitive on long routes into the 20th century and carried bulk cargo into the 1920s and 1930s.

items.bewering: 'n Houerskip dra duisende groot houers vol goedere oor die oseane.
items.bron: https://www.marineinsight.com/the-worlds-biggest-24000-teu-container-ship-delivered/ (largest ships around 24 000 TEU; ordinary ones carry thousands).

items.bewering: Olietenkers dra olie en brandstof in groot tenks diep in die skip.
items.bron: https://glossary.martide.com/oil-tanker/; https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/oil-tanker: crude tankers carry crude oil, product tankers carry refined fuels, in bulk tanks.

items.bewering: Groot hyskrane in die hawe laai die houers op die skip. By die volgende hawe tel hyskrane die houers een vir een van die skip af. Treine en vragmotors vat die houers dan verder die land in.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Container_crane (large dockside ship-to-shore gantry cranes load and unload containers); https://konecranes.com/en-ae/cargo-handling-journey (onward transfer to road trucks and rail wagons). Note only: twin-lift spreaders can lift two small containers at once, but 'een vir een' as a description of lifting containers off in turn is a fair simplification and not false at this level.

items.bewering: 'n Veerboot dra mense en dikwels ook voertuie oor 'n kort stuk water. So 'n boot vaar heen en weer tussen dieselfde twee plekke.
items.bron: https://www.lawinsider.com/dictionary/ferry: a craft carrying passengers or vehicles on a short, frequent route between two points.

items.bewering: Groot passasierskepe (cruiseskepe is een soort) vat mense op lang reise oor die see. Mense slaap en eet dae lank aan boord.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steamship (passenger liners); cruise ships are a type of passenger ship with cabins and dining on multi-day voyages, nothing found to contradict.

items.bewering: 'n Moderne skip het nie meer 'n vuur en 'n ketel vol water nodig nie. Hy word gewoonlik deur 'n groot dieselenjin diep in die skip aangedryf. Die enjin laat 'n skroef onder die water draai.
items.bron: https://trid.trb.org/View/430801 ('Diesels dominate commercial market'); https://www.amnautical.com/a/s/blogs/the-mariners-blog/types-of-marine-propulsion-systems (steam turbines largely replaced by diesel in cargo shipping, remaining on some specialised vessels such as older LNG carriers). The first sentence says 'nodig nie' rather than 'het geen', and the next sentence carries 'gewoonlik', so the few steam-turbine and nuclear exceptions do not make it false.

items.bewering: Die skeprad aan die sykant het byna oral verdwyn.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steamship (screw propellers replaced paddle wheels from the 1840s); https://www.medwayqueen.co.uk/an-astounding-invention.html (paddle survives only for excursions and shallow rivers and lakes). 'byna oral' is correctly hedged.

items.bewering: Baie van die goedere wat van ver af kom, bereik ons land per skip.
items.blok: Wat skepe vandag vir jou doen
items.bron: https://suedafrika.ahk.de/de/content/download/759454/13413091?version=1 (German-Southern African Chamber of Commerce: about 90-98% of South Africa's trade volume moves by ship; the document gives both figures, but either amply supports 'baie').

items.bewering: Kyk 'n slag na die klere en die speelgoed in 'n winkel. Baie daarvan het in 'n houer oor die see gereis. Vervoer op die water het dus 'n invloed op wat jy in 'n winkel kan koop.
items.blok: Wat skepe vandag vir jou doen
items.bron: https://www.alchempro.com/news/apparel-news/china-s-share-exceeds-50-in-south-africa-s-apparel-imports-297780-newsdetails.htm (China about half of South Africa's apparel imports); https://www.engineeringnews.co.za/print-version/south-african-fashion-retailers-boost-local-production-amid-port-delays-2024-02-28 (retailers' stock depends on imports through the ports, and port delays affected it). Toys are not separately quantified, but the sentence says 'baie daarvan' over clothes and toys together, which the clothing evidence carries.

items.bewering: stoomskip: 'n Skip wat deur die krag van stoom aangedryf word.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steamship

items.bewering: ketel: Die sterk houer waarin water gekook word om stoom onder druk te maak.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steamship (boilers raise steam under pressure for the engine)

items.bewering: skeprad: 'n Groot wiel met planke wat die water agtertoe stoot.
items.bron: https://www.medwayqueen.co.uk/an-astounding-invention.html; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steamboat (paddle wheel with paddles or floats pushing against the water)

items.bewering: skroef: Die draaiende deel onder 'n skip wat die water agtertoe stoot.
items.bron: https://www.shippingwondersoftheworld.com/screw_propeller.html; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steamship

items.bewering: houerskip: 'n Vragskip wat baie groot houers vol goedere oor die see dra.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Container_crane; https://www.marineinsight.com/the-worlds-biggest-24000-teu-container-ship-delivered/

items.bron: https://glossary.martide.com/oil-tanker/

items.bewering: veerboot: 'n Boot wat mense heen en weer op 'n vaste roete dra.
items.bron: https://www.lawinsider.com/dictionary/ferry

opsomming: Every claim in the lesson checked out against sources, including the Fulton facts (Hudson 1807, pine wood not coal, a paddle wheel on each side, paying passengers, and that others built steamboats long before him); the only superlative-type claim is already in its careful form, the lesson contains no analogy to test, and two small simplifications (containers lifted 'een vir een', a modern ship 'nie meer' needing a boiler) were judged fair at this level and need no change.
